question: What state is attained by one freed from all diseases, such that union together with yogis becomes the stated result?
premises: One becomes freed from all diseases.
That one is in relation to yogis.
The result stated is union together with yogis.
inference: One freed from all diseases attains union together with yogis.
uncertainties: The nature of that union is not defined in this verse.
plain_english: Freed from all diseases, one attains union together with yogis.
